Trip Builder fully removed, no API mentions, prices removed from India page, new sections (services_in_country, team_info) working correctly, footer has Account section, testimonials are B2B focused.

Navbar has NO 'Contact' link - only Destinations, Services, Technology, About
NO 'Trip Builder' anywhere on homepage (grep confirmed)
NO 'Trip Builder' anywhere on India page
NO 'API Access' or 'API Integration' in footer or technology section

India page hero shows 'Your Destination Management Company for India'

context_for_next_testing_agent: All content changes from major feedback round verified: 1) Trip Builder fully removed (grep confirmed), 2) No API mentions, 3) Navbar has 4 links (no Contact), phone is text-sm, 4) Footer has Account section (Sign In/Sign Up), no Platform, 5) India page completely overhauled with new hero tagline, services_in_country (8 services), team_info section, key_facts with Hi DMC Office/Local Team (no e-Visa), tour packages with Request Quote (no prices), 6) Testimonials are B2B focused about bookings, 7) Experiences is featured service (not compact grid), 8) Text readability improved with higher opacity values.
